006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IBooleanItem;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017
018import java.util.List;
019
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
021
022/**
023 * /** Implements <a href=
024 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">fn:deep-equal</a>
025 * functions.
026 * <p>
027 * This implementation does not implement the three-arg variant with collation
028 * at this time.
029 */
030public final class FnDeepEqual {
031  @NonNull
032  private static final String NAME = "deep-equal";
033  @NonNull
034  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
035      .name(NAME)
036      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
037      .deterministic()
038      .contextDependent()
039      .focusIndependent()
040      .argument(IArgument.builder()
041          .name("parameter1")
042          .type(IItem.type())
043          .zeroOrMore()
044          .build())
045      .argument(IArgument.builder()
046          .name("parameter2")
047          .type(IItem.type())
048          .zeroOrMore()
049          .build())
050      .returnType(IBooleanItem.type())
051      .returnOne()
052      .functionHandler(FnDeepEqual::executeTwoArg)
053      .build();
054
055  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
056  @NonNull
057  private static ISequence<IBooleanItem> executeTwoArg(@NonNull IFunction function,
058      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
059      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
060      IItem focus) {
061    ISequence<?> parameter1
062        = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
063    ISequence<?> parameter2
064        = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1)));
065
066    // FIXME: support implicit timezone
067    return ISequence.of(
068        IBooleanItem.valueOf(parameter1.deepEquals(parameter2, dynamicContext)));
069  }
070
071  private FnDeepEqual() {
072    // disable construction
073  }
074}
